attributes.action: get more funding in women’s health, endometriosis & reducing delays in diagnosis
attributes.additional_details:
Endometriosis and other gynaecological conditions affect millions, yet research remains underfunded and women face lengthy delays in diagnosis. Many suffer for years without answers, specialist care or effective treatment.

I am calling on the Government to increase funding for women’s health, gynaecology and endometriosis research, improve NHS diagnostic services, reduce waiting times and expand access to specialist treatment. Women deserve to be heard, believed and properly cared for.
attributes.background: Increase government funding for gynaecology and women’s health, prioritising endometriosis research, earlier diagnosis, better access to specialist care and effective treatments. Reduce lengthy diagnostic delays and ensure women’s pain is taken seriously, investigated and properly treated.
